overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional social media presence across Bluesky, Mastodon, and LinkedIn, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior. The content consistently attracts strong professional engagement, with research announcements and career opportunities driving high interaction rates relative to follower counts.

contentThemes.description: Research publications and methodological developments around detecting coordinated link-sharing campaigns and disinformation.
Hiring posts and funding opportunities, including postdoctoral roles and PhD student recruitment.
Updates on software releases and platforms like CooRnet v2.0 developed for computational social science.

recommendations: Incorporate visual assets (charts, research graphics, or tool screenshots) to increase visual appeal and further elevate interaction rates, particularly on LinkedIn and Bluesky.
Cross-promote tool releases like CooRnet on LinkedIn to capture institutional and professional audiences that may not be active on niche academic networks.
Increase the posting frequency on Mastodon to sustain deeper technical and methodological discussions with academic peers.

platformInsights.bluesky: The most engaging platform on a per-post basis, showing excellent traction for publication news and student recruitment within the academic community.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as a reliable channel for sharing technical, tool-related updates (like CooRnet) with an engaged network of tech-adjacent scholars.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute volume of interactions (likes and comments) for career milestones, institutional grants, and job postings.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
